A separate direct matching-based exhaustive enumeration for every 1<=m,n<=5 agrees with the formal series, and triangular counts agree; these finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The founding complete multipartite paired-coalition number simply equals graph order; it cannot describe the multiplicity or fragmentation of coalition graphs. The sharp threshold depending only on min(m,n), realization classification with distinct signed magnitudes, exact triangular-endpoint multiplicities and a full component/block enumerator address an intrinsically motivated structural classification and produce reusable exact combinatorial information. The result is not merely a change of variables in the previous paired-domination polynomial, which tracks a single selected set, not a partition or its coalition graph.
